# SasaVenos Recommends Not Training To Failure And Using Deload Weeks For Fatigue Management

SasaVenos recommends managing fatigue by not training to failure for most of the time, especially for strength training, and using rest days, light training days, and deload weeks. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Details

- The best way to manage fatigue is to not train to failure for most of the time, especially if you train for strength. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- You can take rest days. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- You can take light training days, which are super good for recovery and still keeping the movements fresh. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]
- You can also take deload weeks as a tool to really massively heal your fatigue. [src: vid-BBuB0XMVhDw]

## Evidence

- vid-BBuB0XMVhDw (SasaVenos): "So the best way to manage fatigue is to, first of all, not train to failure for most of the time, especially if you train for strength."
